summary: Grupo Aval's Form 6-K reports 2Q2026 results, referencing a previously completed divestiture. On November 27, 2025, Banco de Bogot's subsidiary Multi Financial Holding, Inc. entered a share purchase agreement with BAC International Corporation, a BAC Holding International Corp. subsidiary, to sell 99.57% of Multi Financial Group Inc. (MFG), parent of Multibank, Inc. The transaction closed March 18, 2026, after regulatory approvals and conditions precedent. The filing presents supplemental pro forma financials reclassifying MFG as held-for-sale/discontinued operations. No price, premium, or advisor disclosed. Watch for final audit adjustments to pro forma figures.
